parent_name: Robb Field Ocean Beach Athletic Area
evidence: The OSM park polygon holds two separate facilities about 200 m apart: Barnes Tennis Center (private club courts) and the 12 public Robb Field tennis courts (OSM ways 1423812014-19 and 1423812182-87; City of San Diego park layer lists 12 tennis courts at Robb Field; Esri imagery 2025-09-30 shows full-size tennis courts there). The 400 m same-parent rule chained them into one cluster named Barnes Tennis Center, inflating its tennis count to 39 and absorbing the Peninsula Tennis Club venue. With this row only the 75 m rule links courts in this park.
